introduction: The test feature validates the spec library.

glossary.spec: A four-artifact package representing one feature.

requirements.title: Data model
requirements.rationale: Callers need typed models so that a malformed artifact fails at load time, not at use time.

criteria.condition: a spec directory is loaded from disk
criteria.action: return a Spec whose four artifacts are populated from the files on disk
criteria.contract: a non-nil *Spec and a nil error

criteria.condition: a required artifact file is missing from the spec directory
criteria.action: return a LoadError naming the missing file
criteria.contract: a nil *Spec and a LoadError whose File field is the missing path

criteria.action: for any spec loaded from disk, produce byte-identical files when it is saved again without modification

requirements.title: Cross-file validation
requirements.rationale: A spec whose references do not resolve is a plan with holes in it.

criteria.action: report every criterion that no test verifies and every test that no task owns
criteria.contract: a ValidationResult whose Errors name the uncovered and unowned entities

execution_paths.title: A consumer loads and validates a spec

steps.action: reads and decodes the four artifact files
calls Validate() and inspects the result
